text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Peres loses Labour presidency bid
- Jordan envoy resigns after four days
- Bar-On petitions in High Court today
- Kasparov found Deep Blue all too human
- PA plans U.S.-mediated meeting
- Ya'alon says terror threat persists
- Palestinian, Israeli police officials meet
- NRP new legislator tips balance to right
- Gene linked to drug addiction
- Finance Ministry seeks to redefine property taxes
- Israeli, Croation arms firms mull cooperation
- Central bank: no plan to change shekel devaluation pace
HAARETZ
- Netanyahu hopes ambassador to Jordan reverses resignation
- Mentally-imparied Arab youth on trial for "supporting violence."
- 24 years in jail for rape of step daughters
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Peres after defeat: not resigning, not escaping
- Hundreds of Shas protestors charged high court
- Likud attacks film on incitement to Rabin assassination

- End of Peres era
